name: AgentReplay
tagline: Turn a failed agent run into a replayable test that blocks the same mistake in CI
summary: AgentReplay freezes a production agent run as plain JSON: tool calls, arguments, state before and after, approvals and side effects. You replay it, diff it against a fix, and gate every future model, prompt or tool change on the same failure. Gates are deterministic assertions, so a regression test never depends on a judge model.

metrics.label: vulnerable agent runs caught by the gates, and 20 of 20 hardened runs passed
metrics.source: README.md: CRM adversarial pilot: 20/20 vulnerable runs caught, 20/20 hardened runs passed, 20/20 vulnerable-to-fixed diffs detected.

features: Records tool calls, arguments, responses, pre and post state snapshots, approvals and side-effect diffs as agentreplay.trace.v1 JSON
Deterministic gates such as tool_not_called, requires_approval, tool_order, arg_matches and side_effect_count
Diffs a bad run against a fixed run: changed tool order, arguments and side effects
Node reference SDK plus Python and Go SDKs that emit matching trace hashes, and raw JSON for any other language
Redacts secrets and PII, and scaffolds a CI workflow with agentreplay init
how_it_works: Wrap each tool with the harness so every call is recorded with its state before and after, and the side-effect diff.
Save the run as a trace, add assertions such as never sending an email without approval, and replay it against recorded tool responses.
Run agentreplay gate in CI with --json; a changed model, prompt or tool that brings the failure back fails the build.
quickstart:
node ./bin/agentreplay.js demo
node ./bin/agentreplay.js gate ./traces/billing-bad-run.json
node ./bin/agentreplay.js gate ./traces/billing-fixed-run.json
node ./bin/agentreplay.js diff ./traces/billing-bad-run.json ./traces/billing-fixed-run.json
notes: No gif/mp4/png/jpg assets exist in the agentreplay or agentreplay-site repos (only favicon.svg in the site, and public/ holds the local console html/js). Suggested hero: a screenshot or embed of the live site https://halleylabs.dev/agentreplay-site/ (HTTP 200 confirmed), or render the CLI gate output as a terminal block (bad run FAILED 3/6, fixed run PASSED 6/6; output reproduced locally). The 20/20 pilot figure is from an offline public CRM fixture and was re-run locally (node examples/crm-agent-workflow/pilot.js: cases 20, caught 20, missed 0, fixedClean 20, diffsChanged 20). Version: npm latest is 0.2.0-alpha.2 (confirmed with npm view); the only git tag and GitHub release is v0.2.0-alpha.1 (pre-release). License is Apache-2.0 per LICENSE and package.json, though the GitHub API reports NOASSERTION. README also mentions Witness (halleylabs/witness) as a deployed implementation of the trace ideas. README states the project is an installable alpha, so avoid calling it production-ready.
